D/ [IMP C] ALLECTVS P F AVG

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Allectus (AD 293-296) (Reece Period 14). Obverse description: Radiate long necked bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C] ALLECTVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Galley left with mast and cabin; several rowers; probably waves. Inscription: [VIRTVS] AVG. Type suggests Mint of London. RIC V, pt 2, p. 563, cf. no. 55. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 2.03gms, die…
